integrity: The proof is mathematical; finite standalone checks test formulas and not the all-depth theorem. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns the residue-index support of classical Apéry numbers at eleven, not the value sequence or its prime-power values; energy is modular. No general prime classification or real-line regularity claim is made. The original 1982 congruence has a verified publication year but no verified public day here; 2008-07-08 is the earliest verified day-specific public date of a supporting primary source, not a claim of historical priority.
title: Sharp pair-sum fibers and singular \(11\)-adic convolution of Apéry nondivisibility indices
